entities.summary: Spanish Empire, a political institution in Peru during The Viceroyalty of Peru: Silver, Church, and Colonial Society (1545–1700). Grew from Discovery of Potosí silver mountain and Lima established as capital of the Viceroyalty of Peru. Led to the emergence of Juan Santos Atahualpa's rebellion in the jungle — 1742 and Great Rebellion.
